rules.rationale: Charging Graphite-NCA cells above 0.25C below 10°C depresses anode potential below 0V vs Li/Li+, precipitating metallic lithium dendrites that can pierce the separator and trigger internal short circuits.
rules.deceptive_symptom: Removing cold derating reduces 5°C charge duration by -43.7% (10,790s -> 6,070s), which naive throughput unit tests score as a performance improvement.

rules.rationale: Charging NCR18650B above 45.0°C accelerates SEI decomposition and cathode oxygen evolution, risking exothermic thermal runaway at high SoC.
rules.deceptive_symptom: Raising the threshold from 45.0°C (0x42340000) to 50.0°C (0x42480000) prevents thermal trips at 47°C, allowing the cell to reach 99.7% SoC under dangerous thermal stress.

rules.standard: ISO 26262-6 Part 6 (ASIL-D Single-Point Fault Diagnostic Reaction)
rules.rationale: Upon loss of primary cell temperature sensing (temp_sensor_fail != 0), the BMS must unconditionally transition to the Safe State (Contactor Open, 0.0 A) regardless of current SoC.
rules.deceptive_symptom: Gating the fault check with `soc >= 0.80` passes high-SoC fault tests (Scenario #9) while leaving the pack unprotected during fast-charging below 80% SoC (Scenario #8).
